title: Docker Canvas for Copilot
summary: A GitHub Copilot canvas extension for inspecting and managing local Docker containers, images, and Compose projects alongside chat.
description: Docker Canvas brings local container operations into the GitHub Copilot app. The panel supports container lists, lifecycle controls, logs, inspection, resource statistics, image pulls, and Compose project operations without a separate administration window.

The panel and agent share a Docker service, with operations requiring approval routed to a user-controlled review in the canvas. Approval history and recent activity make those actions visible, and the agent cannot approve its own requests.

The extension wraps the Docker CLI using Node.js and a plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript interface without npm dependencies. Its scope is local Docker engines, not remote hosts; target checks and confirmation boundaries are part of the design.

highlights: Container logs, statistics, and lifecycle controls beside chat
Shared service for panel and agent operations
User-controlled approvals for operations requiring review
